intro.h2: Big remodels, handled like it is our own house
paragraphs: Galindo's Home Improvement LLC does bathroom remodeling and whole-home renovation from 33 Lantern St in Huntington, NY. Jose Galindo runs the work himself, checking in, sending updates and solving the small surprises every remodel turns up. One couple hired us to gut two bathrooms and now says we are the only contractor they will use.

The projects range widely. We have taken a first home from dated to dream home, and re-sided a house, replaced its windows and doors and rebuilt a large section of it. Through every job the crew sweeps the house clean at the end of each day.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling and the rest of the house

items.name: Bathroom gut remodels
items.blurb: We take bathrooms down to the studs and build them back the way you pictured. The primary bath shown has a stacked white tile shower with a hexagon mosaic floor and niche, a quartz-capped bench and wall, frameless glass and matte black fixtures.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with stacked white tile, hexagon mosaic floor, quartz-capped bench and frameless glass

items.name: Tile showers and tub surrounds
items.blurb: Tile sets the mood of a bath. In one hall bath we ran deep navy tile in a herringbone pattern from the tub to the ceiling, framed a penny-tile niche in white and paired it with a navy vanity and round wood mirror.

image.alt: Tub surround in navy herringbone tile with a penny-tile niche, navy vanity and round wood-framed mirror

items.name: Vanities and storage
items.blurb: Good storage makes a shared bath work. This double vanity has two undermount sinks under a white quartz top, with a tall wood linen tower in the middle, black hardware, and a mirror and light fixture over each sink.

image.alt: Wood double vanity with a center linen tower, white quartz top, black faucets and two mirrors

items.name: Whole-home renovations
items.blurb: Bought a house that still feels like grandma's? We help you decide what to tackle first, then take care of paint, finishes and the dated details. Jose even pointed one couple to a good wood reflooring company.

image.alt: Bright living room with a painted white fireplace, wood mantel shelf, light oak floors and sliding doors to a deck

items.name: Attics, basements and additions
items.blurb: Customers have had us finish an attic, build a closet in a child's bedroom and finish basements. On larger jobs we have gutted and rebuilt a big section of a house and handled re-siding, windows and doors as well.

image.alt: Large room with new drywall taped and mudded, recessed lights in the ceiling and buckets of joint compound on the floor

items.title: Updates without chasing
items.text: Customers describe Jose as attentive and easy to reach. One says he was always checking in and providing updates, and another praises how easy it was to communicate with him and his team.

items.title: Pricing you can follow
items.text: One homeowner calls our pricing and invoicing upfront, transparent and very reasonable. Another chose us after several quotes because we could do everything at a midpoint, reasonable price.

items.title: A clean house every night
items.text: We sweep up before we leave. One family says the house was swept clean each day, with little interruption to their schedules during two full bathroom remodels.

items.title: A crew customers name
items.text: Reviews shout out Nelson for skilled, detailed work and Reni and Dougie for carpentry, painting and finishes. Customers notice the people, and many say they will hire us again.

about.text: Galindo's Home Improvement LLC is a Huntington, NY remodeling company led by Jose Galindo. Homeowners say he is knowledgeable from the first meeting, gives honest advice on what to focus on and solves problems as they come up. He brings creative ideas when a design needs one and keeps the job moving. Jose works with a skilled crew, including Nelson, Reni and Dougie, whom customers thank by name. Several clients say they started as customers and ended up feeling like friends, or even family.
about.owner_role: Leads every project; reviews refer to the company as his business

image.alt: Room under renovation with fresh drywall, taped seams and new recessed lighting

process.h2: How a remodel with us works

steps.title: Meet Jose
steps.text: Call (631) 379-5819 between 7 AM and 7 PM, Monday to Saturday. Jose comes out, listens and walks the house with you.

steps.title: Plan the priorities
steps.text: We talk through what matters most, offer honest advice on where to start and put clear, upfront pricing in writing.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: The crew does the demolition, carpentry, tile and finishes, sweeping the house clean before leaving every day.

steps.title: Stay in touch
steps.text: Jose checks in throughout, sends updates and works out solutions when something unexpected turns up behind a wall.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We walk through the finished rooms together so you can see every detail before we hand back your home.

items.name: Rebecca R.
items.text: From the second we met Jose we could tell he was knowledgeable and easy to work with. We hired him to do a pretty big project which included re-siding our home, replacing windows, gutting and rebuilding a large section of our house, replacing doors, gutting and reno of a bathroom, and more. We are very happy with the quality of the work and how easy it was to communicate with Jose and his team.  Special shout out to Reni snd Dougie who did great carpentry and painting/finishes to our home. Will definitely use them for future projects!

items.name: Rhoderick B.
items.text: Jose Galindo and his team did a wonderful job transforming our home from “grandmas” house to our dream home. After my wife and I closed on our first home we were a little overwhelmed after we noticed all the scratched floors, outdated paint and overall dated appearance after the sellers moved out. I had quite a few quotes from multiple contractors and chose Jose as he could do everything we were looking to have done at a midpoint, reasonable price.  Jose and his team were always punctual, friendly, and offered personal advice on what we should concentrate on with our first home reno. Jose also impressed me with his knowledge and problem solving for little bumps during the project. I cannot recommend him enough and my wife and I will continue using him and his team for future projects. PS Jose’s recommendation for a wood reflooring company was also excellent! The before and after pictures will speak volumes. Thank you Jose and team!

items.name: Daniel M.
items.text: We hired Galindo’s Home Improvement to completely gut and remodel two bathrooms in our home, and they did A FANTASTIC JOB! Jose was very attentive, always checking in and providing updates. He used his creativity and expertise to give us exactly what we envisioned, coming up with solutions to any issues that arose. His workers are all highly skilled professionals (shout out to Nelson!), with great attention to detail. They left the house swept clean each day, with little interruption to our schedules. Pricing and invoicing was upfront, transparent and very reasonable. There are a lot of contractor choices in Huntington and Long Island, but we will only be using Galindo’s Home Improvement for any future projects!

service_area.text: We are based at 33 Lantern St in Huntington, NY, and that is where our customers come from. One of them put it this way: there are a lot of contractor choices in Huntington and Long Island, and they will only be using us. If you live nearby and are not sure whether we cover your street, call (631) 379-5819 and ask.

items.q: Do you do full bathroom gut remodels?
items.a: Yes, and they are a big part of what we do. One family hired us to completely gut and remodel two bathrooms, and another had a bathroom gutted and renovated as part of a larger project. The finished baths on this page show the tile, glass, vanities and fixtures we install.

items.q: Can you handle a whole house, not just one room?
items.a: Yes. We have re-sided a home, replaced its windows and doors and gutted and rebuilt a large section of it. For a first-time buyer we refreshed a dated house top to bottom. When a trade falls outside our work, like wood reflooring, Jose can recommend someone good.

We give you clear numbers before the work starts. One customer describes our pricing and invoicing as upfront, transparent and very reasonable. Another compared quotes from several contractors and picked us for a midpoint, reasonable price that covered everything they wanted.

items.q: Will my house be a mess during the remodel?
items.a: We keep it under control. The crew sweeps the house clean at the end of each day, and one family says the two bathroom remodels caused little interruption to their schedules. Talk with Jose about anything specific your household needs, like pets or work-from-home hours.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 7 AM to 7 PM and closed on Sunday. Call (631) 379-5819, or email galindoshomeimprovement@gmail.com with a few photos of the room and a short description of what you would like to change.
